svg.title: Controlled comparison of model fringes
svg.desc: Three calculated double-slit intensity strips share the same screen-position scale. A and B differ only in centre separation; B and C differ only in wavelength. Darker ink denotes greater light intensity, not a dark fringe.

g.text: Compare patterns on the same position scale
Screen position x (mm); x = 0 is the common central axis
Calculated model, not measured data. Darker ink = more light. Same a = 20 μm.
